name: HRishi Jade JCPL
player_statement:
A complete player, HRishi Jade JCPL has made a big mark in cricket. With 10 turns at the crease, they've hit a top score of 23, with an average of 13.57 and a quick strike rate of 133.80. Their knack for hitting big shots is evident with 8 sixes and 5 fours.

Equally good at bowling, they've bowled 6.0 overs, taking 2 wickets at an economy rate of 5.67. Despite a few wides, their accuracy is top-notch, making them a key player for their team.
